description: Defines IPC (Inter-Process Communication) connector interfaces, message serialization/deserialization, IPC channel management, and related classes for the Thunder framework.

classes.name: IMessage
classes.description: Interface for messages with serialization/deserialization capabilities.

classes.name: IIPC
classes.description: Interface representing an IPC message with label, parameters, and response.

classes.name: IPCMessageType
classes.description: Template class for specific IPC message types with serialization support.

classes.name: IPCChannel
classes.description: Abstract class managing IPC channels, registration, invocation, and response reporting.

classes.name: IPCChannelType
classes.description: Template class extending IPCChannel, managing source, extension, and IPC link handling.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes an IMessage into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into an IMessage.

methods.name: Procedure
methods.description: Defines procedure to handle incoming IPC messages.
